name: Jacob Smith
caption: The owner of 96 Promotions in April and May 2009 and the new boss of its June return as Wrestling Unplugged, called Jay; as Jayson Smith, the owner who in October and November 2009 lost a fight with Jason Burrows for the company and signed Shane Hunt as his prodigy.

tenures.source: Its eXpose pages of April and May 2009 (the owner who gave away 'four-hundred and fifty FREE tickets out of like five-hundred total' and bought a ring that collapsed) and its Parental Advisory 11 (14 June 2009), where he sits behind the desk for 'his first Parental Advisory'. After the relaunch of 18 October 2009: its eXposes of 26 October, 3 November and 9 November 2009 (the owner, 'the Handsome Owner', called Jay; 'the creator of 96'); the 3 November page has him beaten by Burrows for ownership.

name: Samantha Ross
caption: The co-owner who came on 'to aid Jacob in running 96' and was demoted when a bought-in co-owner arrived.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 6 May 2009: 'Samantha Ross ... She knew coming on to aid Jacob in running 96'; the eXposes of 27 April and 17 May show her and Jacob as the two owners.

name: Trent Medlow
caption: Bought his way into 96's co-ownership with a briefcase of cash, refereed the 6 May main event, where Salim Raj hit him with the Jai Ho, and on 17 May demanded to be treated like an owner.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 6 May 2009 (a briefcase of $100 bills and a note asking to be named Co-Owner of 96 and special guest referee; he rings the bell as 'new Co-Owner Trent Medlow') and of 17 May (he demands to be treated like an owner).

name: Marissa Child
caption: Alex Kent's manager, who told him on 27 April that 'something big is happening tonight'.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 27 April 2009: Alex Kent 'coming face-to-face with his manager Marissa Child'.

name: Alex Kent
caption: Billed in the Elite three-way of 27 April 2009 and beaten by Salim Raj in the main event of 6 May.

tenures.source: Its eXposes of 27 April (the Elite Championship three-way, ended outside by Salim Raj's interference) and 6 May 2009 (beaten by Salim Raj in the main event).

name: Michael Ahriman
caption: Won the Elite title in a three-way on 27 April 2009 and was its champion until Jinx took it before the June pay-per-view.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 27 April 2009: 'Winner: Michael Ahriman (Elite Champion)'; the 6 May page calls him 'Elite Champion Michael Ahriman', and on 17 May he beats Chad Vargas in the main event.

name: Salim Raj
caption: Won the Commonwealth title in a three-way on 27 April 2009 and lost it to Makayla Fox on 17 May.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 27 April 2009 (won the Commonwealth Championship three-way) and its eXposes of 6 and 17 May (beat Alex Kent, then lost the title to Makayla Fox).

name: Makayla Fox
caption: Became Commonwealth champion on 17 May 2009 and kept the belt through Screaming For Vengeance and Parental Advisory 11.

tenures.source: Its eXposes of 27 April, 6 May (billed for the Lugar title) and 17 May 2009 ('crowning her the new Commonwealth champion'), Screaming For Vengeance and Parental Advisory 11 (the title defences).

name: Carmine Vestieri
caption: A friend of the co-owner welcomed backstage on 27 April 2009, spelled Veseteri; on the October and November 2009 pages the Lion, eliminated from the Chaotic Cage and winner of his single matches against October Doom and Brandon Maddox.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 27 April 2009 (spelled Veseteri): Samantha runs to him backstage, 'Do you know how long I was waiting for you to accept my invite into this company?'. After the relaunch of 18 October 2009: its Revolution pay-per-view (eliminated from the cage, then attacked Jinx), its eXposes of 26 October (beat October Doom with the Fade to Black), 3 November and 9 November 2009 (beat Brandon Maddox).

name: Akilliz
caption: A character introduced by a vignette on 6 May 2009 who beat Chuckles and interfered against Brandon Maddox on 17 May.

tenures.source: Its eXposes of 6 May 2009 (a vignette of an asylum-bred character who 'comes out to play') and 17 May (beat Chuckles with the ROtd; blindsided Maddox).

name: Chuckles
caption: Lost to Akilliz on the eXpose of 17 May 2009.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 17 May 2009: lost to Akilliz.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Chris X
caption: Billed against Brandon Maddox on 17 May 2009 and robbed of the win when Akilliz interfered.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 17 May 2009: billed against Brandon Maddox, who won after Akilliz interfered.

name: Skit-Zo
caption: Debuted at Screaming For Vengeance on 7 June 2009 and won the One Shot title a week later.

tenures.source: Its Screaming For Vengeance (beat Hallow Wicked in his debut) and Parental Advisory 11 ('Here is your winner and the new One Shot Champion...SKIT-ZO').

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Eric Dickey
caption: The new GM of 96 in October 2009, who told the owner to calm down.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 26 October 2009: 'the new GM of 96 wrestling'.

name: Nathan Lancaster
caption: Runner-up in the Chaotic Cage, holder of the Prodigy title from 18 October 2009 and declared Revolution champion on 3 November.

tenures.source: Its Revolution pay-per-view (the last man pinned in the Chaotic Cage), the eXposes of 26 October (retained the Prodigy title over Rico Sutton), 3 November (pinned Johnny Styles) and 9 November 2009 (Revolution champion).

name: Colton Vargas
caption: The first man in the Chaotic Cage on 18 October 2009 and a challenger for the Revolution title in November.

tenures.source: Its Revolution pay-per-view (first in the cage) and its eXposes of 3 and 9 November 2009 (a win over Jinx by disqualification; a no contest with Nathan Lancaster).

identity.note: Shares a surname with Chad Vargas of Wrestling Unplugged and the spring's 96. Nothing on either's pages ties them: different finishers, the Moonshiner and the Stroke, and no page calls them kin or one wrestler.

name: Melody
caption: Called 96's first and only diva, eliminated first from the Chaotic Cage on 18 October 2009.

tenures.source: Its Revolution pay-per-view (the first man eliminated from the cage) and its eXposes of 26 October, 3 and 9 November 2009 (called '96's first and only Diva').

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Rico Sutton
caption: Challenged Nathan Lancaster for the Prodigy title on 26 October 2009 and feuded with Jinx.

tenures.source: Its eXposes of 26 October (lost the Prodigy title match to Nathan Lancaster), 3 November (attacked Jinx and wrote 'DLS' on him) and 9 November 2009 (lost to Jinx).

name: October Doom
caption: Beaten by Carmine Vestieri on 26 October 2009 and by Melody on 9 November.

tenures.source: Its eXposes of 26 October (submitted to Carmine Vestieri), 3 November (an elimination tag draw) and 9 November 2009 (lost to Melody).

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.
The 96 pages bill 'October Doom'; the older company's Doom wore a mask and a green cloak, and nothing on the 96 pages ties the two, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Osh Vaughan
caption: Signed by Jason Burrows on 9 November 2009 and promoted as the future of 96; he struck Johnny Styles with a chair and the Revolution belt on Nathan Lancaster.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 9 November 2009: 'the former NMW superstar Osh Vaughan', signed by Burrows as 'the future of 96 Promotions'.

name: Lobo
caption: A former NMW wrestler who ran in on the 9 November 2009 main event.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 9 November 2009: 'Former NMW superstar Lobo', who interrupted the Revolution title match.

identity.note: The same ring name stands on other wings' records. Nothing on this wing's pages ties this wrestler to any of them, so the rows stay apart until a source says it is one wrestler.

name: Shane Hunt
caption: Appeared at the close of the 9 November 2009 eXpose beside the owner as his prodigy.

tenures.source: Its eXpose of 9 November 2009: the owner stands beside Shane Hunt, 'SMITH'S PRODIGY'.
